# Example Presentation Script

---

## Slide 1 - Title

Welcome to this presentation. Today we will walk through a brief example of how slides-to-video works.

---

## Slide 2 - Overview

This tool takes three inputs: a PDF slide deck, a markdown script like this one, and a short voice sample. It clones your voice and generates a narrated video automatically.

---

## Slide 3 - Conclusion

That's all there is to it. Thanks for watching.
